ui.otomeForge.common.tagline: A love story made from your own characters
ui.otomeForge.common.title: Otome Forge
ui.otomeForge.errors.adminAccess: This needs admin access. Open Marinara Engine through localhost, or set ADMIN_SECRET on the server and enter the same value in Settings → Advanced → Admin Access.
ui.otomeForge.errors.ageGate: Confirm that you are 18 or older to open this.
ui.otomeForge.errors.badFormat: The model’s reply wasn’t in the expected format. Try again.
ui.otomeForge.errors.badRequest: That request wasn’t quite right. Try again.
ui.otomeForge.errors.busy: Still working on the last request. Try again in a moment.
ui.otomeForge.errors.conflict: That changed somewhere else. Try again.
ui.otomeForge.errors.declined: The model declined to write that. Try again, or ask for something else.
ui.otomeForge.errors.noConnection: No connection is set for this. Choose one in Settings.
ui.otomeForge.gate.confirmedNote: You confirmed you are 18 or older. Turning a setting down never asks.
ui.otomeForge.gate.intro: NSFW Heat, Dark romance and image ratings above SFW are for adults only. Confirm once to unlock them for every story.
ui.otomeForge.gate.lockedNote: NSFW Heat, Dark romance and image ratings above SFW ask for an 18+ confirmation first.
ui.otomeForge.gate.revokeText: Every story drops to SFW Heat, Angst and SFW images. You can confirm again later.
ui.otomeForge.gate.selfReported: This is self-reported and saved with today’s date. You can withdraw it any time in Settings → Content.
ui.otomeForge.gate.statement: I am 18 or older. Love interests are always adults. This is fiction.
ui.otomeForge.gate.title: Before we go further
ui.otomeForge.settings.connectionsIntro: Which of your Engine connections writes each part of this story.
ui.otomeForge.settings.debugCopied: Copied. Paste it into a bug report.
ui.otomeForge.settings.debugCopyFailed: Couldn’t copy: the browser blocked the clipboard.
ui.otomeForge.settings.debugHow: Turn on Debug mode in the Engine’s settings, or start the server with DEBUG_AGENTS, to log prompts.
ui.otomeForge.settings.debugOn: Debug mode is on: every prompt Otome Forge sends is written to the Engine’s server log as [debug/otome-forge/…], and the Engine logs image prompts too.
ui.otomeForge.settings.draftKept: An unfinished setup is kept on this device.
ui.otomeForge.settings.imagesGallery: Painted images are saved to the Engine’s Global Gallery. Each one is paid for on your image connection and never repainted without your tap.
ui.otomeForge.settings.languageHint: Prose is written in this language. Image prompts stay in English.
ui.otomeForge.settings.noDraft: No setup draft is kept on this device.
ui.otomeForge.settings.noStory: Start a story first; its settings appear here.
ui.otomeForge.settings.privacyAdminSecre: Playing from a phone or another device needs ADMIN_SECRET set on the server and the same value entered in Settings → Advanced → Admin Access.
ui.otomeForge.settings.privacyBackups: Package documents travel with Engine backups and profile exports, so a backup or an export carries your stories with it.
ui.otomeForge.settings.privacyBrowser: A few conveniences stay in this browser only (your look and the setup draft). Browser storage is shared with the Engine page, so other installed packages could read it.
ui.otomeForge.settings.privacyDelete: To remove a story and everything in it, delete it from Your stories.
ui.otomeForge.settings.privacyDeviceKeys: This browser keeps only “{{look}}” (your look) and “{{draft}}” (an unfinished setup).
ui.otomeForge.settings.privacyDocuments: Your stories, cast, bibles and progress are saved as package documents in Marinara Engine’s own database, on the computer that runs it.
ui.otomeForge.settings.privacyGate: The 18+ confirmation is self-reported and stored with the date you gave it.
ui.otomeForge.settings.privacyProviders: Every prompt goes to the model provider of the connection you chose. With a cloud provider, it leaves your device.
ui.otomeForge.settings.privacySafari: Safari may clear browser storage after about 7 days without a visit.
ui.otomeForge.settings.privacyShared: Package documents aren’t isolated per package: other installed packages could read them.
ui.otomeForge.settings.saved: Saved. New scenes follow it from now on.
ui.otomeForge.setup.archetypeBrilliantMo: A genius who treats people as experiments, until you.
ui.otomeForge.setup.archetypeGentleLiarS: Every kindness is true. Nothing else is.
ui.otomeForge.setup.archetypeGildedTyran: Owns the city, and expects to own you.
ui.otomeForge.setup.archetypeLaughingStr: All charm and no past, and the past is coming.
ui.otomeForge.setup.archetypeLoyalBladeS: Sworn to someone else. Bleeding for you anyway.
ui.otomeForge.setup.archetypeRuinedSaint: Once the city’s hope. Now its quiet sin.
ui.otomeForge.setup.archetypesHint: A seed for someone new. You name them; the story does the rest.
ui.otomeForge.setup.askHint: Places, story moments and other art wait for your tap. Base looks always ask.
ui.otomeForge.setup.bibleAdult: Love interests are always adults: the age must be a whole number, 18 or older.
ui.otomeForge.setup.bibleCanonText: Wherever this bible and the card disagree, the card is right.
ui.otomeForge.setup.bibleEditHint: Your edits steer the story from now on. Love interests are always adults and never in a school or student role, and one secret stays at stage 4 (the Wound).
ui.otomeForge.setup.bibleInvalid: The story can’t use this bible as it is. Check the fields and save again.
ui.otomeForge.setup.bibleNeedBirthday: Write the birthday as MM-DD, for example 03-14.
ui.otomeForge.setup.bibleNeedMaskTells: The mask needs {{min}} to {{max}} tells, one per line.
ui.otomeForge.setup.bibleNeedWoundSecret: Keep at least one secret at stage 4, the Wound.
ui.otomeForge.setup.bibleNoSchoolRole: The role must be an adult one: no school or student roles.
ui.otomeForge.setup.bibleNotYet: Not written yet. It appears once forging reaches them.
ui.otomeForge.setup.bibleSaved: Saved. The story follows your edits from now on.
ui.otomeForge.setup.bibleSecretTellsMax: A secret has at most {{tellsMax}} tells.
ui.otomeForge.setup.bibleSpoilerText: Their bible holds their secrets, their wounds and where their story is heading. Reading it spoils the surprises.
ui.otomeForge.setup.cardsHint: A card stays canon: the story never contradicts it.
ui.otomeForge.setup.castEmpty: No one yet. Pick from your characters or an archetype.
ui.otomeForge.setup.castFull: That’s {{max}}, a full cast. Remove someone to add another.
ui.otomeForge.setup.castHint: Choose {{min}} to {{max}} love interests, from your cards or the archetypes below.
ui.otomeForge.setup.castNote: Two to five. They want you, and something else too.
ui.otomeForge.setup.connectionChatHint: Writes their replies in your phone threads.
ui.otomeForge.setup.connectionCompressHi: Summarises what happened, so they remember it.
ui.otomeForge.setup.connectionNarrationH: Writes the story, and every job below unless you choose otherwise.
ui.otomeForge.setup.connectionStructured: Plans the world, the bibles and each chapter.
ui.otomeForge.setup.connectionsTitle: Who writes it, who paints it?
ui.otomeForge.setup.contentNote: You set the limits. The story keeps them.
ui.otomeForge.setup.costLooksNote: base looks, only when you tap Paint the cast
ui.otomeForge.setup.costNoImages: No image connection: nothing is painted.
ui.otomeForge.setup.costText_one: About {{count}} model call to write the world.
ui.otomeForge.setup.costText_other: About {{count}} model calls: one for the world, one for each love interest’s bible.
ui.otomeForge.setup.createFailed: The story couldn’t be made. Try again.
ui.otomeForge.setup.createNeedsGate: This story needs the 18+ confirmation. Confirm it in the Content step, or lower Heat, Darkness or the image rating.
ui.otomeForge.setup.customFull: That’s {{max}}, the most you can add.
ui.otomeForge.setup.darkPromise: In Dark romance, every darkness has a reason, a hidden cost and lines they won’t cross. Your choices always include refusing, and the story honours what you pick.
ui.otomeForge.setup.darknessAngstText: Danger aimed at the world, their pasts and their enemies, never at you.
ui.otomeForge.setup.darknessDarkText: Menace and coercion may be aimed at you.
ui.otomeForge.setup.darknessGentleText: Warm and low on danger. Conflict stays between people.
ui.otomeForge.setup.deleteText: This removes the story, its cast, their bibles and its painted images from this Engine. It can’t be undone.
ui.otomeForge.setup.draftKept: Your draft stays on this device until the story is made.
ui.otomeForge.setup.expressionsHint: Tender, flustered, cold, hurt and angry faces for each look, painted in the background.
ui.otomeForge.setup.forgeNote: Stay a moment. They’re almost here.
ui.otomeForge.setup.forgeStepStopped: Stopped before it finished. Try again.
ui.otomeForge.setup.goalHint: Something to fight for that isn’t them.
ui.otomeForge.setup.goalPlaceholder: What do you want, apart from love?
ui.otomeForge.setup.heatExplicitText: Intimate scenes are written in full.
ui.otomeForge.setup.heatFadeText: Intimacy reaches the page, then fades before it turns explicit.
ui.otomeForge.setup.imagesOptional: Optional. Without images, everyone appears as initials in their own colours.
ui.otomeForge.setup.languageHint: Prose is written in this language.
ui.otomeForge.setup.liNotesPlaceholder: A look, a job, a habit, a secret you’d like…
ui.otomeForge.setup.limitFixed: Kept as a Line by your Heat or Darkness
ui.otomeForge.setup.limitFixedNonConsent: Changes only with Dark romance, NSFW Heat and the 18+ confirmation
ui.otomeForge.setup.limitsHint: Allow: may be written. Veil: happens off the page. Line: never written. Changing Darkness keeps the levels you set and gives the rest its defaults.
ui.otomeForge.setup.needCast: Choose at least two love interests.
ui.otomeForge.setup.needLiName: Give each original love interest a name.
ui.otomeForge.setup.needLiPronouns: Choose pronouns for each love interest.
ui.otomeForge.setup.needNarration: Choose a connection for the story.
ui.otomeForge.setup.needPremise: Write a premise, or let Surprise me write one.
ui.otomeForge.setup.needTextConnection: Add a text connection in the Engine first.
ui.otomeForge.setup.noCards: No character cards yet. Original archetypes work just as well.
ui.otomeForge.setup.noImageConnections: You have no image connections. Add one in the Engine to paint your cast.
ui.otomeForge.setup.noPersonas: You have no personas yet. Create one in the Engine’s Personas panel, then come back.
ui.otomeForge.setup.noTextConnections: No text connections yet. Add one in the Engine’s Connections panel, then come back.
ui.otomeForge.setup.paintNoConnection: No image connection: your cast appears as initials in their own colours. Add one in Settings → Images to paint them.
ui.otomeForge.setup.paintOffer: Their looks are painted only when you ask.
ui.otomeForge.setup.premisePlaceholder: A city of clockwork canals, a masked ball, and a murder only you saw…
ui.otomeForge.setup.protagonistNote: This is your story. Bring yourself.
ui.otomeForge.setup.ratingHint: Separate from Heat: it decides what images may show.
ui.otomeForge.setup.ratingSuggestiveText: Alluring and flirtatious, no explicit nudity.
ui.otomeForge.setup.reviewNote: One last look before the story begins.
ui.otomeForge.setup.reviewPaintFailed: This image didn’t finish. Paint it again, or skip it.
ui.otomeForge.setup.reviewPromptHint: Review or edit the image prompt before it is sent.
ui.otomeForge.setup.startOverText: Your draft is cleared and setup begins again.
ui.otomeForge.setup.surpriseHint: Asks your model for a premise. It replaces what is written here.
ui.otomeForge.setup.titleHint: Leave it empty and the story names itself.
ui.otomeForge.setup.traitsHint: Up to five words that describe you.
ui.otomeForge.setup.withoutImages: Playing without images: the cast appears as initials in their own colours. Add an image connection any time in Settings → Images.
